$NKTR These two articles are from Supergrok 
 
Alopecia Areata and the a priori case for durability 
 
 
Your reasoning is coherent and rests on solid mechanistic and cross-indication data: 
 
The same molecule, same doses (18/24 µg/kg), and same Treg-selective pharmacology produced durable clinical benefit + sustained CD25bright elevation in psoriasis and AD after only 12 weeks of induction. 
In the REZOLVE-AA Phase 2b, patients received longer induction (36 weeks), and those who had not yet reached SALT ≤20 continued for another 16 weeks. Deepening of response was observed during that extension—exactly what you would expect if the Treg effect continues to build with longer exposure. 
 
There is no biological reason to expect that Tregs in alopecia areata patients would behave fundamentally differently from those in psoriasis or AD patients once expanded and activated by the same agent. The underlying hypothesis is restoration of immune regulation, not a disease-specific pathway. 
 
So the a priori expectation (based on mechanism + prior clinical data) is that off-drug durability in the AA cohort should also be strong, at least in the responders. The pending 6-month off-drug follow-up data are the real test of that expectation.

$NKTR  
 
After the next data release in Q4  2026  showing Off Drug Durability of rezpeg again.  I have posted summery of Durability finding from the Phase 1b and Phase 2b clinical.   
 
This is what will make rezpeg the + $ 3 B/year drug 
 
 
Summary of  the key durability findings. 
 
Phase 1b studies (psoriasis and atopic dermatitis) 
12 weeks of dosing followed by 36 weeks off treatment. 
Clinical improvements (PASI in psoriasis; EASI and vIGA-AD in AD) were largely durable for the full 36-week off-drug period in responders. 
In AD, among week-12 responders on the higher dose, 71% maintained EASI-75 and 80% maintained vIGA-AD 0/1 responses at 36 weeks after the last dose. 
 
 
These clinical responses were accompanied by sustained elevations in CD25bright Tregs.his remains the clearest demonstration of true off-drug durability to date. 
 
REZOLVE-AD Phase 2b (atopic dermatitis) – on-treatment maintenance 
After 16-week induction, patients who responded were re-randomized to monthly or quarterly dosing through week 52. 
High rates of maintained response at week 52 (e.g., 71–83% maintained EASI-75 on the 24 µg/kg regimens). 
New and deepening responses continued to emerge during the maintenance period (including 2- to 5-fold increases in EASI-100 rates). 
These data show durability while remaining on less-frequent dosing, not pure off-drug remittance. 
 
REZOLVE-AA Phase 2b (alopecia areata) 
36-week induction + 16-week blinded extension (to week 52) for patients who had not yet reached SALT ≤20. 
Responses continued to deepen during the additional on-treatment period (new SALT ≤20 responders appeared in ~29–31% of extension patients on active drug; none on placebo). 
Off-treatment durability data (the planned ~6-month / 24-week follow-up after stopping therapy) have not yet been reported. 
 
 
Summary: The strongest pure off-drug evidence is the Phase 1b finding of sustained clinical benefit and elevated CD25bright Tregs for at least 36 weeks after only 12 weeks of treatment. Longer induction and on-treatment deepening have been seen in both AD and AA Phase 2b studies, but the critical off-drug durability readout in alopecia areata is still pending.

The administration said the goal is to encourage generic drug manufacturers to shift production to the United States.
